full_judgment: 3. Mr Md Fazlul Karim, learned Advocate for the petitioners, submits that the High Court Division disposed of the issue of limitation summarily without noticing and discussing that the plaintiff-respondent's suit was one under section 39 of the Specific Relief Act and that the impugned kabala deed is dated 8-11-1982, and that the suit was filed on 24-3-1988. The High Court Division failed to notice that the suit was barred by limitation under Article 91 of the First Schedule to the Limitation Act.
